jobs.title: Warwick Melrose Dallas Hotel - Security
jobs.description:
About the Role:

The Security position at Warwick Melrose Dallas Hotel is pivotal in ensuring the safety and security of guests, staff, and property within the hotel premises. This role involves proactive monitoring and rapid response to any security incidents, maintaining a secure environment that supports a positive guest experience. The Security team member will collaborate closely with hotel management and local law enforcement when necessary to uphold safety standards and compliance with regulations. Through vigilant observation and effective communication, the role aims to prevent theft, vandalism, and other security breaches. Ultimately, this position contributes to the hotel's reputation as a safe and welcoming destination for all visitors.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in a security role, preferably in a hospitality or customer service environment.
  • Valid security guard license or certification as required by state law.
  • Ability to pass background checks and drug screening.
  • Strong observational skills and the ability to remain calm under pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in hotel or hospitality security.
  • First aid and CPR certification.
  • Familiarity with security technology such as CCTV systems and access control.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Training in conflict resolution and emergency response.

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor hotel premises through regular patrols and surveillance systems to detect and prevent suspicious activities.
  • Respond promptly and effectively to security incidents, emergencies, and alarms, ensuring guest and staff safety.
  • Maintain detailed and accurate reports of daily activities, incidents, and irregularities such as property damage or theft.
  • Collaborate with hotel management and local authorities to address security concerns and implement safety protocols.
  • Provide assistance and guidance to guests and staff regarding security policies and emergency procedures.

Skills:

The required skills such as vigilance, quick decision-making, and effective communication are essential for daily security operations, enabling the security professional to identify potential threats and respond appropriately. Observational skills help in monitoring surveillance equipment and conducting thorough patrols to maintain a safe environment. Preferred skills like familiarity with security technology enhance the ability to use modern tools for surveillance and incident documentation. Interpersonal skills are crucial for interacting with guests and staff, providing reassurance and clear instructions during emergencies. Additionally, conflict resolution and emergency response training empower the security team member to handle challenging situations calmly and efficiently, ensuring minimal disruption to hotel operations.

jobs.title: Overnight Hotel Security Officer — Guest Safety
jobs.description:
DoubleTree by Hilton DFW North in Irving, TX is seeking an Overnight Security professional to protect guests and hotel property. Join a hotel team that values safety, courtesy, and a calm demeanor during emergencies.

You will perform foot patrols, monitor alarms, respond to incidents, assist guests, and uphold hotel policies. The role requires English communication, physical stamina, and the ability to work on-site shifts in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

jobs.title: Hotel Security & Guest Safety Specialist
jobs.description:
Hilton Dallas/Rockwall Lakefront is seeking a Security Officer to protect guests and employees and safeguard hotel assets. You will patrol the property on foot, observe for safety risks, and respond to emergencies in a courteous, controlled manner.

You will handle security calls, document incidents, enforce hotel policies, and assist with guest needs while maintaining a calm, professional demeanor and a neat appearance as required by the team handbook.

jobs.title: Night-Shift Hotel Security & Guest Experience
jobs.description:
Peachtree Group is seeking an overnight Security professional for the AC Hotel/Moxy in Dallas. You will patrol interior and exterior areas, respond to emergencies, and investigate incidents to protect guests, associates, visitors, and property while maintaining a welcoming environment.

In this role you’ll collaborate with hotel leadership to promote safety, write clear incident reports, and provide visible, courteous service to guests.

jobs.title: Hotel Security Officer - Luxury Hotel
jobs.description:
Hotel Security - Luxury Hotel Environment

Company: Coastal International Security, Inc.
Location: Fort Worth, TX 76107 (Cultural District)
Compensation: $19.50/hr
Job Type: Part-Time
Schedule: Friday & Saturday | 6:00 PM - 2:00 AM
About the Role

This position is ideal for candidates who understand that appearance, tone, and demeanor are just as important as vigilance and sound judgment. If you carry yourself with confidence, treat every guest interaction as an opportunity to elevate the experience, and take pride in representing a luxury brand, we want to hear from you.

At Coastal International Security, we don't just provide security - we represent presence, professionalism, and the poise expected in five-star environments. Our Guest Safety Ambassadors are the face of both Coastal and our client, blending safety awareness with elevated guest service to ensure every encounter is smooth, respectful, and on standard.
Mandatory Requirements - Must Meet All to Be Considered
  • Active Texas Security License (Guard Card)
  • Active TOPS Card - required at time of application; candidates without a current TOPS Card will not be considered
  • Proven experience in hospitality, guest services, or professional security
  • Availability to work Friday and Saturday nights, 6:00 PM - 2:00 AM, including holidays
What You'll Do
  • Greet and assist guests, visitors, and staff with warmth, professionalism, and a five-star standard of service
  • Maintain polished grooming, posture, and presentation consistent with luxury client standards at all times
  • Monitor access points and surveillance systems with discretion and attentiveness
  • Conduct thorough property patrols and maintain accurate, detailed incident reports
  • Enforce site safety and guest-service protocols consistently and respectfully
  • De-escalate situations with composure and sound judgment, prioritizing guest experience throughout
  • Partner with hotel management, law enforcement, or emergency responders when required
  • Uphold a confident, approachable, and calm presence in all guest-facing interactions
What You Bring

Required:
  • Active Texas Security License (Guard Card)
  • Active TOPS Card
  • Demonstrated experience in hospitality, guest services, or professional security environments
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Professional appearance and command presence befitting a luxury hotel setting
  • Reliability, integrity, and accountability - consistently, not occasionally
  • Ability to remain composed under pressure while maintaining client-facing poise

Preferred:
  • CPR, First Aid, or formal de-escalation training
  • Prior experience in a luxury hotel, resort, or upscale venue environment
  • Restaurant experience
  • At least one professional reference available upon request
Important Notice

All employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of onboarding, licensing verification, and uniform/appearance review in accordance with Coastal and client presentation standards. A professional reference is required prior to hire.
Why Coastal International Security
  • Represent a company trusted by premier luxury hospitality brands
  • Work in an upscale, professional environment where your presence and service make a real difference
  • Build your professional credibility in settings where standards are high and recognition follows
  • Join a team that values integrity, client partnership, and doing the job right

Coastal International Security, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.v

jobs.description:
Hotel Security OfficerJob DescriptionThe Hotel Security Officer is responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment for hotel guests and employees.

The officer will patrol the hotel premises, monitor surveillance cameras, and respond to any security incidents or emergencies.

Responsibilities:
  • Patrol hotel premises to ensure the safety and security of guests and employees.
  • Monitor surveillance cameras and report any suspicious activity.
  • Respond to security incidents or emergencies and take appropriate action.
  • Assist guests with safety and security concerns.
  • Collaborate with hotel management and local law enforcement agencies as needed.
  • Complete incident reports and maintain accurate records.
  • Conduct regular safety and security inspections of hotel facilities.
  • Provide training to hotel staff on safety and security procedures.

Requirements:
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Prior experience in security or law enforcement preferred.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to remain calm and professional in high stress situations.
  • Strong attention to detail and observation skills
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Physical ability to stand, walk, and climb stairs for extended periods of time.
  • Valid driver's license and clean driving record

Benefits:
We offer a competitive wage, Health and Dental Insurance, company paid Life Insurance, Short Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, Vision, Critical Illness, Accidental, 401(k) and company match, paid vacation, paid holidays, paid sick days, free hotel rooms and hotel discounts. E.O.E.
